title: WF03 ADP-12 integration stability blocker: transient local test-server bind collisions surfaced as ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS
summary: Diagnosed the ADP-12 WF-02 Step 04 integration blocker as a transient environment/harness issue in the aggregate integration suite: local in-process HTTP test servers could fail fast on temporary bind collisions, surfacing Windows NTSTATUS ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS. Added deterministic bind-retry loops in affected test harness servers and revalidated build/integration success.

root_cause.details: Integration tests in EXT-01 and EXT-02 spin up localhost HTTP servers on fixed ports. Server startup previously returned immediately on any initial listen failure. Under aggregate test execution, transient bind races/time-wait windows on Windows can momentarily produce ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS and destabilize run outcomes.

changes: Updated tests/integration/ext01_service_task_test.zig LocalHttpServer.run to retry listen up to 50 attempts with short backoff before failing.
Updated tests/integration/ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig LocalWebhookServer.run to retry listen up to 50 attempts with short backoff before failing.
Kept scope minimal to integration harness startup logic; production runtime code unchanged.

commands.command: cmd /c "set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& zig build test-integration && echo INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%"
commands.evidence: Cleaning test database... Test database cleaned. INTEGRATION_EXIT_CODE=0

prevention: For integration tests that bind localhost ports, treat initial bind failures as transient and retry with short backoff before failing.
Prefer deterministic harness startup/readiness behavior over single-attempt listen semantics in multi-suite runs on Windows.
